points.K1: 为什么要做辐射安全告知
points.K2: 身边有放射性，你要知道
points.K4: 运动负荷室人员受照很低
points.K5: 辐射工作人员有剂量上限
points.K6: 怀孕的工作人员有专门限值
points.K8: 剂量计戴在身上和手上
points.K16: 药物注入体内，相机不放射
points.K18: 排泄物有放射性，但量很小
points.K21: 离院病人的急诊与防护
points.K22: 污染物品收进指定容器
points.K23: 等检测放行，房间可能关闭
points.K25: 溢洒常在哪里，多少算溢洒

shots.scene: 欣欣站在医院核医学科走廊，门上有电离辐射警告标志，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a hospital corridor next to a door with an ionizing radiation warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲核医学身边的辐射安全。

shots.scene: 三个图标：注射器、地上一滴液体、急救十字
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a syringe, a single drop on the floor, and a medical first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 病人、溢洒、急救，一个个说清楚。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着白大褂，在心脏运动负荷试验室的跑步机旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a white coat stands beside a treadmill in a cardiac stress test room.
shots.narration: 阿杰在附属医院的运动负荷室实习。

shots.scene: 老周在跑步机上，胳膊上贴着留置针
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks on the treadmill with an IV cannula taped on his arm.
shots.narration: 今天的病人老周，刚注射过放射性药物。

shots.scene: 阿杰后退一步，一脸紧张
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a step back with a nervous look.
shots.narration: 阿杰有点慌：我会不会被照坏了？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 别慌，也别大意，先把道理弄明白。

shots.section_title: 为什么要做辐射安全告知
shots.scene: 一叠空白法规文本和一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank regulation booklets and a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 核医学监管严格，要定期安全培训。
overlay: 为什么要做辐射安全告知

shots.section_title: 为什么要做辐射安全告知
shots.scene: 王老师给一屋子医护和学生上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a short training to doctors, nurses and students in a meeting room.
shots.narration: 州法规要求，尽量告知可能受照的人。

shots.section_title: 身边有放射性，你要知道
shots.scene: 医院平面图上，运动负荷室、病房、急诊几个图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A simple hospital floor plan with the stress test room, a ward and the emergency room highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 注射后的病人，会去医院很多地方。
overlay: 身边有放射性，你要知道

shots.section_title: 身边有放射性，你要知道
shots.scene: 阿杰认真看着欣欣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student listens carefully to the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 常和他们打交道，就要懂一点辐射。

shots.scene: 太阳、飞机、山峰、房屋、空气四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the sun, an airplane, a mountain, a house, and air swirls. No people.
shots.narration: 阳光、空气、建材、高海拔、坐飞机，

shots.scene: 一个普通人图标被淡淡的光点包围
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary person icon surrounded by faint glowing dots. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 美国人均每年约360毫雷姆。

shots.section_title: 运动负荷室人员受照很低
shots.scene: 运动负荷室里，阿杰站在跑步机旁，一根很短的刻度条
shots.prompt_en: In the stress test room the young male student stands beside the treadmill; a very short gauge bar floats beside him.
shots.narration: 运动负荷室的人员，受照一般很低。
overlay: 运动负荷室人员受照很低

shots.section_title: 运动负荷室人员受照很低
shots.scene: 两根刻度条：天然本底和运动负荷室，后者更短
shots.prompt_en: Two blank gauge bars side by side, the second one much shorter than the first. No people.
shots.narration: 病人多的医院，最高约75毫雷姆一年。

shots.section_title: 辐射工作人员有剂量上限
shots.scene: 小研穿工作服，旁边一把空白刻度尺带红色上限线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a work coat stands beside a blank ruler with a red upper limit line.
shots.narration: 天天和放射性药物打交道的人，
overlay: 辐射工作人员有剂量上限

shots.section_title: 辐射工作人员有剂量上限
shots.scene: 全身轮廓和手的轮廓，各有一条上限线
shots.prompt_en: A whole body outline and a hand outline, each with its own red limit line. No people.

shots.section_title: 怀孕的工作人员有专门限值
shots.scene: 孕妇图标旁一条更低的红线
shots.prompt_en: A pregnant woman icon beside a lower red limit line. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 怀孕的技师可以继续工作。
overlay: 怀孕的工作人员有专门限值

shots.section_title: 怀孕的工作人员有专门限值
shots.scene: 空白的工作安排表，有人调整一格
shots.prompt_en: A blank work schedule chart with one slot being moved. No people.
shots.narration: 孕期限值500毫雷姆，不超就行。

shots.scene: 一根刻度尺，实际值远低于红线
shots.prompt_en: A blank gauge with a short green bar far below the red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 这些限值，都算工作人员的安全年剂量。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着红线摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the red limit line and shakes its head gently.
shots.narration: 技师实际一年约200毫雷姆，远低于上限。

shots.section_title: 剂量计戴在身上和手上
shots.scene: 小研胸前别着剂量计，手指戴着指环剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a dosimeter badge on her chest and a ring dosimeter on her finger.
shots.narration: 技师身上戴一个剂量计，手上也戴。
overlay: 剂量计戴在身上和手上

shots.section_title: 剂量计戴在身上和手上
shots.scene: 日历一年的格子逐月累加
shots.prompt_en: A one-year calendar with months filling up one by one into a total bar. No people.
shots.narration: 全年剂量累计起来，确保安全。

shots.section_title: 剂量计戴在身上和手上
shots.scene: 阿杰站在远处，一根很短的刻度条
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a distance with a very short gauge bar beside him.
shots.narration: 偶尔接触的人，受照只是很小一部分。

shots.scene: 示意图：α 粒子被一张纸挡住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: alpha particles stopped by a single sheet of paper. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子，一张纸就能挡住。

shots.scene: 示意图：β 粒子被一层衣服或塑料板挡住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: beta particles stopped by a layer of clothing or a plastic plate. No people.
shots.narration: β粒子，衣服或不到一英寸塑料就行。

shots.scene: 示意图：γ 射线被混凝土墙或铅板挡住大部分
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: gamma rays mostly stopped by a thick concrete wall or a lead plate. No people.
shots.narration: γ要几英寸到几英尺混凝土，或铅。

shots.scene: 铅罐和注射器铅套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lead container and a lead syringe shield. No people.
shots.narration: 所以放射性药物，常装在铅罐里。

shots.scene: 人站在源旁，钟表指针转得很少
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a person icon near a small glowing source with a clock showing a short time. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 时间：在源附近，待得越短越好。

shots.scene: 人从源旁走远，箭头拉长
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a person icon walking away from a glowing source with a long arrow. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 距离：离源越远越好。

shots.scene: 人躲在墙后，射线被墙挡住
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a person icon sitting behind a wall that blocks rays from a glowing source. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽：用墙、铅板挡在中间。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写有向下箭头的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign with a downward arrow.
shots.narration: 防护的总原则：合理可行，尽量低。

shots.scene: 钟表、箭头、盾牌三个图标合成一个
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a clock, an arrow and a shield, joining together into one badge. No people.
shots.narration: 时间、距离、屏蔽，就是三个关键。

shots.scene: 小研用棉签擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes a small area of a countertop with a swab, wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 技师会定期擦拭取样，

shots.scene: 小研拿着巡测仪沿地面检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the floor with a handheld survey meter.
shots.narration: 再用仪器巡测，看有没有滴漏污染。

shots.scene: 地上一滴液体的特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a single small drop on a clean floor. No people.
shots.narration: 哪怕只有一两滴，也算溢洒。

shots.scene: 吸水垫圈住液滴，周围拉起警戒线
shots.prompt_en: An absorbent pad placed around the drop, with a small barrier tape around the area. No people.
shots.narration: 受过训练的人马上控制，不让它扩散。

shots.scene: 手套、隔离衣、鞋套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, a disposable gown, shoe covers and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 手套、隔离衣、鞋套，也是防护的一环。

shots.scene: 老周坐在候诊椅上，皱着眉问小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits in a waiting chair and asks the female graduate student a worried question.
shots.narration: 病人担心辐射，你可以这样说：

shots.scene: 小研微笑着解释
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and explains gently to the older man.
shots.narration: 对儿童、成人，甚至孕妇都很安全。

shots.section_title: 药物注入体内，相机不放射
shots.scene: 注射器把液体注入手臂血管的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a syringe injecting liquid into a vein in an arm. No people.
shots.narration: 药物是液体，注射进血液里。
overlay: 药物注入体内，相机不放射

shots.section_title: 药物注入体内，相机不放射
shots.scene: 显像设备的探头图标，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: An imaging camera detector icon with a green check and no rays coming out of it. No people.
shots.narration: 显像的相机只接收，自己不产生辐射。

shots.scene: 两个刻度条：常见检查和常见影像检查，差不多高
shots.prompt_en: Two blank gauge bars of similar height side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 约等于两次胸片，或晒20天太阳。

shots.scene: 沙漏和逐渐变淡的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass next to a person icon whose glow fades step by step. Icon only, no people.
shots.narration: 多数情况下，48小时内就从体内消失。

shots.section_title: 排泄物有放射性，但量很小
shots.scene: 急救室里，医护围着病床
shots.prompt_en: Nurses and a doctor gather around a hospital bed in an emergency room.
shots.narration: 注射过药物的病人，也可能需要急救。
overlay: 排泄物有放射性，但量很小

shots.section_title: 排泄物有放射性，但量很小
shots.scene: 血滴、尿杯图标，旁边一个很小的辐射点
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blood drop and a urine cup, each with a tiny radiation dot. No people.
shots.narration: 血、尿等排泄物有放射性，但量很小。

shots.section_title: 排泄物有放射性，但量很小
shots.scene: 生物危害警告标志放大
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign shown large. No people.
shots.narration: 相比之下，血液传播的病原体更要防。

shots.scene: 医护正在抢救，欣欣在一旁举起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: A medical team performs emergency care on a patient while the panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside them.
shots.narration: 救命第一，绝不能因为辐射而耽误。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手伸向门把手和电脑键盘，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand reaching for a door handle and a keyboard, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 碰过排泄物后，别再摸门把手、电脑。

shots.scene: 门口画着停止手势，旁边是巡测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A doorway with a stop hand icon and a survey meter icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 没经过检测放行，别去其他区域。

shots.section_title: 离院病人的急诊与防护
shots.scene: 老周躺在急诊推车上，医生不知情的问号
shots.prompt_en: The older man lies on an emergency stretcher; a question mark floats above the doctor's head.
shots.narration: 病人离院后再来急诊，医院可能不知道。
overlay: 离院病人的急诊与防护

shots.section_title: 离院病人的急诊与防护
shots.scene: 医护戴好手套和隔离衣
shots.prompt_en: Nurses put on gloves and disposable gowns before treating a patient.
shots.narration: 急救时常规穿戴的防护用品，一般够用。

shots.section_title: 污染物品收进指定容器
shots.scene: 小研把用过的纱布放进带辐射标志的桶里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts used gauze into a lidded bin with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 污染的物品，由技师收进指定容器。
overlay: 污染物品收进指定容器

shots.section_title: 等检测放行，房间可能关闭
shots.scene: 急救结束，医护站在房间里等待
shots.prompt_en: After emergency care, the medical team waits inside the room calmly.
shots.narration: 抢救完，接触过的人先留在房间里。
overlay: 等检测放行，房间可能关闭

shots.section_title: 等检测放行，房间可能关闭
shots.scene: 小研用巡测仪检查医护的手和鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the hands and shoes of a nurse with a survey meter.
shots.narration: 技师逐个检测，没问题才放行。

shots.section_title: 等检测放行，房间可能关闭
shots.scene: 房门挂上空白暂停使用牌，然后又取下
shots.prompt_en: A blank closed sign hangs on a room door, then is taken down. No people.
shots.narration: 污染重的房间先关闭，清干净再开放。

shots.scene: 小研准备给老周注射，台上有铅罐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student prepares an injection at a table with a lead container; the older man sits with his arm out.
shots.narration: 我们看一个场景。

shots.scene: 一滴液体从台边落到地上
shots.prompt_en: A single drop falls from the edge of the table onto the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 一不小心，药物掉到了地上。

shots.scene: 小研吃了一惊，用戴手套的双手捂住脸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers her face with her gloved hands in surprise.
shots.narration: 这就是一次溢洒。

shots.section_title: 溢洒常在哪里，多少算溢洒
shots.scene: 运动负荷室图标被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A stress test room icon with a treadmill, circled. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒最常出现在运动负荷室。
overlay: 溢洒常在哪里，多少算溢洒

shots.section_title: 溢洒常在哪里，多少算溢洒
shots.scene: 地上一滴液体，旁边一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A single drop on the floor with a magnifying glass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能只有一滴，也要按溢洒处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰深呼吸，站在原地
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a deep breath and stands still in the room.
shots.narration: 在场的人先冷静，没人有即时危险。

shots.scene: 小研抬手示意大家站好，医生也照做
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to guide everyone; a doctor follows her instruction.
shots.narration: 技师会指挥所有人，医生也要听。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手想帮忙，被打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a helping hand reaching toward a spill, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 再想帮忙，也别伸手。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套用吸水垫处理，阿杰站在一边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves handles the spill with absorbent pads while the young male student stays back.
shots.narration: 清理交给技师，以免越弄越大。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在原地等待，小研给他检测
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waits in place while the female graduate student checks him with a survey meter.
shots.narration: 技师确认之前，先留在房间里。

shots.scene: 房门挂着空白暂停使用牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank closed sign hangs on the stress test room door. No people.
shots.narration: 房间可能暂时关闭，等放射性清除。

shots.scene: 日程表上后面的病人照常
shots.prompt_en: A blank appointment list where later slots still have green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 后面的病人，可能还能照常检查。

shots.scene: 王老师在旁边看小研巡测、记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator watches and takes notes while the female graduate student completes a survey.
shots.narration: 技师在辐射安全负责人监督下按州法规巡测。

shots.scene: 王老师整理一叠空白文件，点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator organizes a stack of blank documents and nods.
shots.narration: 法规上的事务，交给专业人员处理。

shots.scene: 采血管图标和日程箭头，采血在检查之前
shots.prompt_en: A blood sample tube icon placed before an imaging scan icon on a timeline arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 要抽血化验，最好在检查前做完。

shots.scene: 时间轴上检查后有一段等待
shots.prompt_en: A timeline arrow with a waiting gap after the scan icon before the blood tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 来不及的，检查后至少等24小时再抽。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套拔除留置针，放进带标志的容器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves removes an IV cannula and places it into a shielded container.
shots.narration: 门诊病人的留置针，由核医学技师拔。

shots.scene: 病房里的病人手上留着留置针
shots.prompt_en: The older man rests in a hospital ward bed with an IV cannula still in his arm.
shots.narration: 住院病人需要的话，可以留着。

shots.scene: 冲管示意图，放射性在血管里而不在针里
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: an IV line being flushed, the glowing dots in the vein not in the cannula. No people.
shots.narration: 冲管后，放射性主要在血液里。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研微笑回答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question; the female graduate student smiles and answers.
shots.narration: 有疑问，随时问核医学技师。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上有钟表、箭头、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a clock, an arrow and a shield icon.
shots.narration: 最后，记住几句话。

shots.scene: 钟表、箭头、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clock, an arrow and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 时间短、距离远、有屏蔽。

shots.scene: 急救十字和绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A medical cross icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 注射过药物的病人，抢救照样第一。

shots.scene: 溢洒的液滴和停止手势
shots.prompt_en: A drop on the floor next to a stop hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒了，别伸手，等技师放行。

shots.scene: 剂量计和指环剂量计图标
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge icon next to a ring dosimeter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 技师身上手上都戴剂量计，受照很低。

shots.scene: 阿杰微笑着扶老周下跑步机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student smiles and helps the older man step off the treadmill.
shots.narration: 阿杰不慌了，照顾老周也更安心。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰在核医学科门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student and the young male student at the nuclear medicine department entrance.
shots.narration: 懂辐射，不慌张。下次见！
